paper.title: Towards Long-horizon Embodied Agents with Tool-Aligned Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.central_claim: VLAs-as-Tools: a high-level VLM agent invokes a family of specialized VLA tools through a typed tool-family interface (explicit tool selection and in-execution progress feedback enabling event-triggered replanning), with Tool-Aligned Post-Training (invocation-aligned training units and tool-family residual adapters) so VLAs faithfully follow invocations; across five simulated benchmarks it improves pi05 success by 8.9 points on average and Non-biased Rate by 15.0 points, and raises real-world Franka success from 16.7% to 58.3% under matched data and compute.

G.reason: gap 具体：VLA 执行强但长程推理弱，agent 系统规划强但依赖弱工具，且 VLA 并非天然可作工具(受场景先验偏置)。作者自测量化了残余问题：在 SFT VLA 上直接套规划器反而下降(−11.8/−12.0)，无 TAPT 时 LIBERO-IF Non-biased 仅 31–40%。近邻/谱系(π0.5 内部子任务预测、SayCan、Code-as-Policies、AtomicVLA、RoboClaw)已命名并区分“agent 可见调用”。扣分：与 AtomicVLA/RoboClaw 无实验比较；残余缺口(新原语、单机器人、动态场景)部分已写明，但“规划器不训练、不覆盖未学原语”的边界较简。

M.reason: 操作与问题对准：类型化调用(g,z)让规划器的请求落到有界执行；进度头+阈值监控把重规划改为事件触发；TAPT 把训练单元对齐到推理时调用单元；每族 LoRA 适配器保留预训练语义。能提出可区分预测并被检验(仅套规划器会下降；去掉对齐接口增益消失)。弱点：进度目标是线性时间代理，作者自承非语义完成度，监控能否识别“卡住”靠定性图而非精度/召回；“适配器缓解预训练语义退化”除 LIBERO-IF 外无直接检验。
